claims.claim: Within its admitted rational expression language, an exact unequal substitution at a point in the public domain with all guards defined and true is a valid counterexample to the encoded universal equality; a finite pass remains unproved.

findings.title: Escaped surrogate answer text lost final receipt after known charges
findings.counterexample: ASCII JSON with answer_text containing escaped lone surrogate passed the old candidate envelope and extracted a nonencodable string. Final answer hash raised after two inert requests and82 microusd durable settlement; campaign retained100000 hold and no run.json.
findings.resolution: bounded_text validates UTF-8 scalar text before extraction; repaired probe reports artifact_validation_failure, freezes run.json, settles82 microusd at campaign level with zero hold.
findings.limits: No real provider requests or money; run-shaped inert transport and separate public synthetic task.

findings.title: Checker hashed malformed inputs before its type/encoding guard
findings.counterexample: check_panel(17,...) raised AttributeError before its parser; raw lone surrogate also raised before bounded rejection.
findings.resolution: artifact_hash only hashes UTF-8 strings; malformed candidate returns typed artifact error and None answer fallback.

findings.title: Prepared plan omitted execution/billing owner source pins
findings.counterexample: Initial source_pins named only checker/spec; changing copied runner bytes did not affect loaded plan manifest or execution admission.
findings.resolution: Source pins now include runner, live campaign, both ledgers and provider. Modified copied runner now refuses before output creation or dispatch. Loaded manifest remains the original snapshot; restart/new preparation is required after source change.
findings.limits: Plan pins source bytes, not the Python interpreter, libraries, remote service behavior or user consent.

findings.title: Malformed provider metadata can poison the frozen failure receipt
findings.counterexample: Valid ASCII response JSON with finish_reason="\ud800" and ordinary answer/cost. Response freeze fails after41 microusd settlement; catch retains the poisoned metadata, so final freeze raises again. No run.json; campaign stays100000 reserved while run ledger records41 and blocked=true.
findings.repair: Validate/sanitize external metadata before adding it to persistent records, or fall back to a serializable digest/error record while retaining known charge and explicit failure. Preserve raw provider digest and do not silently normalize mathematical answer text.
findings.limits: Budget remains conservative and further campaign admission is blocked by unfinished reservation; this is lost failure receipt/reconciliation, not cap bypass.
findings.resolution: Provider admission marks malformed text/metadata explicitly, preserves raw digest and lossless malformed_response_ascii_json; freeze_json uses ASCII escaping for evidence. Re-probe freezes provider_or_accounting_failure with41 microusd spent, blocked=true and99959 campaign hold. No final receipt exception remains for this counterexample.

findings.title: Summary accepts stale-hash and negative-cost receipt as observed live evidence
findings.counterexample: Copy a valid synthetic run receipt, change spent_microusd to-1000000, retain original run.sha256. summarize accepts it, labels observed_live_receipts, reports money_usd=-1 and complete_cost_accounts=1.
findings.repair: Require exact receipt sidecar hash and strict finite/nonnegative typed budget/timing/token/status/offline fields before summarization; validate internal seed/run/answer bindings. Preserve explicit trusted-evaluator boundary.
findings.limits: This is untrusted/corrupted receipt ingestion. A manually changed receipt is not an actual provider billing result; no forged mathematical grade or authority was demonstrated.
findings.resolution: read_frozen_receipt refuses stale/missing digest and invalid numeric/binding fields. Re-probe rejects original tamper by hash and rehashed negative cost by integer admission; valid frozen control is accepted. Coordinated data+hash replacement remains outside local custody authentication.
